purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The City of Hanover documents ALKIS parcel boundaries in its official city map. The state LGLN catalog describes an official no-auth cadastral WFS with Hannover coverage; GetCapabilities and DescribeFeatureType succeeded and exposed parcel geometry and native cadastral identifiers. Three bounded feature requests (exact point, small bbox, XML POST) received generic HTTP 400 gateway rejections. No feature or geometry sample was returned.
registryAssessment: The City of Hanover identifies its official city map as incorporating ALKIS parcel boundaries. The Lower Saxony official catalog publishes an unauthenticated INSPIRE WFS for cadastral parcels and describes Hannover coverage; capability and schema are accessible, but bounded feature requests were rejected by the service gateway.

attempts.result: HTTP 200; official capabilities list `cp:CadastralParcel`, supported CRS including EPSG:4326.
HTTP 200; schema includes `geometry`, `nationalCadastralReference`, `inspireId`, and other non-owner fields.
HTTP 400 generic “Zurückgewiesene Anfrage”; no feature data returned. Separate exact-point Intersects GET and bounded XML POST also returned HTTP 400. No broader query attempted.
